system.description: • Effect: As part of your action, spend 1 Glamour: one creature within 60ft makes a Will save against your Class Save DC. On a failure, until the end of its next turn it takes one real creature or object you choose for an illusion: it will not attack or avoid it, and that creature has Advantage on attacks against it.

activities.name: Seed of Doubt
activities.text: As part of your action: one creature within 60ft makes a Will save against your Class Save DC; on a failure, until the end of its next turn it takes one real creature or object you choose for an illusion (it won't attack or avoid it, and that creature has Advantage on attacks against it).
